mapper.select: SELECT A.PRODUCT_ID, A.USER_NO, A.TITLE, A.DESCRIPTION, A.PRICE, A.CATEGORY_GROUP, A.CATEGORY_MID, A.CATEGORY_SCLS, A.AREA_GROUP, A.AREA_MID, A.AREA_SCLS, A.QUANTITY, A.UNIT_GROUP, A.UNIT_CODE, A.DESIRED_SHIPPING_DATE, A.SALE_STATUS, (SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM tb_product_image WHERE PRODUCT_ID = A.PRODUCT_ID AND REPRESENT = 1 LIMIT 1) AS IMAGE_URL, O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_NO, O.USER_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.PAYMENT_STATUS, O.TOTAL_ITEM_AMOUNT, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, O.TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT, DATE_FORMAT(O.ORDERED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS ORDERED_AT, O.PAID_AT, I.PRODUCT_NAME, I.UNIT_PRICE, I.QUANTITY FROM tb_product A INNER JOIN tb_order_items I ON A.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN tb_orders O ON I.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND O.ORDER_STATUS != 'READY' ORDER BY O.ORDERED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_product A INNER JOIN tb_order_items I ON A.PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN tb_orders O ON I.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND O.ORDER_STATUS != 'READY'

SELECT I.*, P.TITLE, P.DESCRIPTION, P.CATEGORY_GROUP, P.CATEGORY_MID, P.CATEGORY_SCLS, (SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM tb_product_image WHERE PRODUCT_ID = I.PRODUCT_ID AND REPRESENT = 1 LIMIT 1) AS IMAGE_URL FROM tb_order_items I LEFT JOIN tb_product P ON I.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE I.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, PAYMENT_STATUS = #{paymentStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'CANCEL' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
